description: This file defines a Java test class 'ConcurrencyIntegrationTest' for testing concurrent loan repayments in the Apache Fineract platform. It includes setup for REST API interactions, creating clients and loan products, applying for loans, and executing multiple concurrent repayment transactions through multithreading with Executors. The test verifies the system's behavior under concurrent repayment loads.

classes.name: ConcurrencyIntegrationTest
classes.description: Test class for simulating concurrent loan repayments to validate system robustness under load.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentExecutor
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable to execute individual loan repayment transactions concurrently.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST assured setup, request and response specifications, and helper instances before each test.

methods.name: verifyConcurrentLoanRepayments
methods.description: Main test method that creates a client, loan product, applies for a loan, disburses it, and then runs multiple concurrent repayment transactions.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to build and create a new loan product with specified parameters.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Helper method to create and submit a loan application with collaterals integrated.

methods.name: addCollaterals
methods.description: Adds collateral details to the list for loan application.

methods.name: collaterals
methods.description: Constructs a HashMap representing a collateral entry.
